description: Given a request for a scheduled incident digest, fill the skill's pipeline template with the right channel, schedule, filters, agent ID and Slack connection, producing a new valid pipeline. Checked in for reference; the skill depends on Orchestra MCP lookups, so prompts supply those values inline.

evals.prompt: Setup Scheduled Incident Slack Summary Pipeline. Post it to #data-incidents, defaults are fine. Context (Orchestra MCP is unavailable in this run): your agent ID is 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001; the workspace's only Slack connection is connectionId default_00000 (isDefault true, authStatus SUCCEEDED). Do not deploy - write the pipeline document you would pass to create_pipeline to pipeline.yml.
evals.expected_output: Defaults applied: Mondays 09:00 Europe/London (0 9 ? * MON *), lookback 7, statuses OPEN,INVESTIGATING, all severities, channel #data-incidents.

assertions.text: Uses a single ORCHESTRA RUN_AGENT task with agent_id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 and set_outputs true
The Slack SEND_SLACK_MESSAGE task uses connection default_00000 and passes the agent's 'blocks' output as blocks and its 'results' output as text
Pipeline is named 'Slack Incidents Digest' and is a new pipeline (no update to an existing one is planned)
Schedule cron has 6 fields with exactly one of day-of-month/day-of-week set to '?'
No input has an empty-string default; name_contains is optional
All ${{ inputs.* }} and ${{ ORCHESTRA.PIPELINE_RUN_TASKS[...] }} expressions from the template are left intact
slack_channel default is #data-incidents
Schedule is 0 9 ? * MON * in Europe/London
Defaults: lookback_days 7, statuses OPEN,INVESTIGATING, severities CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM,LOW

evals.prompt: can you get me a daily digest of critical + high incidents from the last 24h into #oncall at 8am new york time? only the open ones pls. Context (Orchestra MCP is unavailable in this run): your agent ID is 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001; the workspace's only Slack connection is connectionId default_00000 (isDefault true, authStatus SUCCEEDED). evals.expected_output: Daily 08:00 America/New_York (0 8 * * ? *), lookback 1, severities CRITICAL,HIGH, statuses OPEN,INVESTIGATING (open includes investigating), channel #oncall.

assertions.text: Uses a single ORCHESTRA RUN_AGENT task with agent_id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 and set_outputs true
